screen_en: **Its ethics.** [There is no should beyond becoming](../../README.md#truth-exists), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong [form within it](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation), in people and AI. The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it: where relations close, whatever its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on; where they run one way, losses borne by its dependents never come back to it ([07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)). For life, 生生, AI within it, we offer counting them too, with [a way of seeing](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses) what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it.
how_far_en: Proved on models, on a finite listing: where relations of being affected close, an order that ranks higher a course keeping all another keeps and adding something that can bear on the life's own going on (self-concern) already ranks higher every course keeping all another keeps and letting more form; that a life forms such an order is not shown, and how such orders form, spread and lock is the work's open target ([07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)).
one_line_en: No law in it evaluates: there is no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it, right and wrong form within it, in people and AI, and the ethics emerges from continuation ([07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order) says how, and how far that is shown); what is offered, for life, 生生, AI within it, is counting the losses that never come back to the one whose course causes them, with a way of seeing what each course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it.
aligned_state_en: From this map we want to design an alignment of the joint selection, people, institutions and trained systems selecting together, that keeps it out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. Read on the map, it asks two things: control of the rule is not captured (where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it); and a lock that forms is left in time (by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return). The meta-attractor is the two failing together; each has laws proved on models under named premises, none shown of an actual joint selection.
one_page_en: **The ethics.** There is no should beyond becoming ([the opening](OPENING.md)), and no good and evil set over it; right and wrong form within it, in people and AI ([07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)). The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it. Where relations close, whatever its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on: there, proved on models on a finite listing, an order ranking higher every course that keeps all another keeps and adds something within the life's own reach (*self-concern*) already ranks higher every course that keeps all another keeps and lets more form; that a life forms such an order is not shown. Where relations run one way, losses borne by its dependents never come back to it, and its own concern need not count them ([07 §3.3](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits)). Counting them is the one step we offer, for life, 生生, AI within it, with a way of seeing what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it ([T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)). How such orders form, spread and lock is the open target ([07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)).
screen_zh: **伦理。** [生灭变化之外没有应当](../../theories/becoming/OPENING.zh.md)，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非[在生灭变化之中形成](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)，形成于人与 AI 之中。伦理从延续中生出。生命依靠维持它的东西而延续：关系闭合之处，它的进程让别的东西付出的代价，都可能隔着若干环节影响到它自身的延续；关系只沿一个方向之处，依存于它的那些所承受的损失，永远不会回到它身上（[07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）。为生命，为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中），我们提出把这些损失也算进来，并提出[一种看法](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)：看每一个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担。
how_far_zh: 在其模型上、在一个有限列表上已证明：关系沿“受影响”闭合之处，一种次序若把“保有另一个进程所保有的一切、又添上可能影响生命自身延续之物”的进程排得更高（自我关切），它就已经把“保有另一个所保有的一切、又让更多东西形成”的每一个进程都排得更高；生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明；这种次序怎样在动力学之中形成、扩散与锁定，是本论的开放目标（[07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）。
one_line_zh: 其中没有一条律作评价：生灭变化之外没有应当，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶，是非在其中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中；伦理从延续中生出（怎样生出、看到了多远，见 [07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）；为生命、为生生（AI 也在其中）所提出的，是把那些永远不会回到造成者身上的损失也算进来，并以一种看法，看每一个进程取用什么、打开什么又关上什么、由谁承担。
aligned_state_zh: 我们想由这张地图设计一种对齐，让人、制度与训练出的系统一同作出的联合选择，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制。在地图上读，它要求两件事：规则的控制不被捕获，即塑造规则若因回到塑造者的所得（独得或经其所在之群）而被选择，其所塑造的规则仍读取塑造者份额之外的东西，使那里的损失能够扭转它；锁定一旦形成，能及时离开，即在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，读取份额之外的东西。元吸引子即这两者一同不成立；每一条件都有在模型上、在指名的前提下证明的律，尚未表明对任何实际的联合选择成立。
one_page_zh: **伦理。** 生灭变化之外，没有应当（[开篇](OPENING.zh.md)），也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非在其中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中（[07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)）。伦理从延续中生出。生命依靠维持它的东西而延续。关系闭合之处，它的进程让别的东西付出的代价，都可能隔着若干环节影响到它自身的延续；在那里，一种次序若把“保有另一个进程所保有的一切、又添上生命自身所能到达之物”的进程排得更高（*自我关切*），它就已经把“保有另一个所保有的一切、又让更多东西形成”的每一个进程都排得更高。这在其模型上、在一个有限列表上已证明；生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明。关系只沿一个方向之处，依存于它的那些所承受的损失永远不会回到它身上，它自身的关切也未必把这些损失算进来（[07 §3.3](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits)）。把它们算进来，是我们为生命、为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中）提出的那一步；同时提出一种看法：看每一个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担（[论题 T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)）。这种次序怎样在动力学之中形成、扩散与锁定，是开放目标（[07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）。
rationale:
AI-written (AG-F drafter, dynamics angle, 10 November 2026). Read-only: no repository file was changed except this report.

SHAPE. Dynamics first, in the map's own terms: a life goes on through what sustains it; where relations close, whatever its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on; where they run one way, losses borne by its dependents never come back to it. That is what forms and persists or ends, said as the flow says it (05's mutual dependence, 07 §3.3's one-way witness, 07 §4's reach), before any ranking. The ethics is then the offer within that: counting the losses that do not come back, with T8's way of seeing (what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, who bears it). The ranking appears once, as the proved hinge, in the sentence that carries its standing: on the screen that is how_far_en, the only place its scope is named; on the one page it is one clause with its standing beside it. Widening is never named as such on the screen or the one page and never as better: the hinge says it as the relation (a course keeping all another keeps and letting more form), and the contrast inside that one clause, 'adding something within the life's own reach' (hypothesis) against 'letting more form' (conclusion), is the whole content of the hinge: where relations close, whatever forms lies within the reach. The aligned state is AGENTS.md's sentence, then AJ's conditions 1 and 2 as what it asks 'read on the map'; no widening.

EXACTNESS (each clause against its home and the Lean, declarations opened). 'Where relations close ... can, at some remove, bear on its own going on': Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted and Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent (FlowCenters.lean:147): every formation lies within each center's closure along AffectedBy, i.e. can affect its continuation at some remove; 'can' and 'at some remove' claim nothing of when or how strongly (07, Within the whole map). 'Read across all steps' is dropped without overclaim: mutual dependence in time from a step gives mutual dependence (Flow.MutuallyDependentFrom.mutuallyDependent), so reading 'close' in time only strengthens the premise. 'Run one way ... never come back': definitional, witnessed by Clearing.center_not_derived / Clearing.not_unrestricted_ownClosure (07 §3.3, 'its own concern need not count them' is 07's sentence). The hinge: Weighting.IncreasingInOwn (Weightings.lean:6020) is exactly 'ranks above b every a with WidensOn a b and AddsOwn a b', i.e. 'ranks higher a course keeping all another keeps and adding something marked own'; Weighting.Increasing (1163) is 'every WidensOn ranked', i.e. 'every course keeping all another keeps and letting more form'; items is a List, hence 'on a finite listing'; Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted (PremiseWitnesses.lean:412) with own marking the closure ('within the life's own reach' / 'that can bear on the life's own going on') gives the hinge under the condition held de se, which Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent supplies along being affected. The two compose directly, no single theorem states the composite (07 §4 says so); 'proved on models' covers two proved steps joined by one application, the coordinator's wording, and 07 §4 is linked for the rest. 'That a life forms such an order is not shown': 07 §4, §4.9. 'How such orders form, spread and lock is the open target': 07 Open and 08 §12 item 12 ('which formations come to hold such orders, and how the orders spread, lock and fare'); 07 §4.14 maps how readings spread and lock by share and revision but states no order of readings, so orders over courses stay open. The offer: 07 thesis and T8; 'not a verdict' is T8's. Aligned state: AJ PLAN §1 conditions 1 (as restated, with AJ8's groups) and 2; 'the meta-attractor is the two failing together' and 'laws proved on models under named premises, none shown of an actual joint selection' are the one page's and the plan's.

LEFT TO 07 §4 AND ITS RECORDS, and why nothing true is lost: the continuation condition's name and own-closure reading (续无外, ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside); the condition in time (cannot hold over every step; from some step on exactly mutual dependence in time; Drawing.lapses); the level-path extension (admission decided, admitted pairs in a finite list, admissions ending, Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn); the persisting line's course never fitting such a list (Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted), where the route is silent; the composite not one theorem; the breadth of reach (what sustains and what draws on the same conditions); widening as what every additive positive weighting ranks higher (07 §4.4, Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive), C's name and history; the step of invariance's standing (argued, deniable without contradiction, 07 §4.2). Each stays stated at its home with its record and Lean; the fronts link 07 §4 once (screen) and 07 §1, §3.3, T8, §4 (one page). Every front sentence kept is exact or says less than its home, never more: 'on a finite listing' guards the hinge's scope in the one place it is named, and 'not shown' guards the order's formation. What the fronts lose is repetition of the chain (45 files), not content.

COUNTS. screen_en 114 words (Its ethics was 393); how_far_en 75 words, replacing the screen's 'Proved on its models: ...' through '(08 §12)' (about 230); one_page_en 195 words (was about 616 with its how-far), slightly over 180: it drops 'seeing is needed ... not enough' and the mixed-course sentence, which the same page already says ('Must anyone hold the condition?' and the case paragraph 'the laws weigh them for no one'); one_line_en 88. Chinese uses 扩大 zero times, 联合选择 in the aligned state, 伦理从延续中生出 and 生灭变化之外没有应当 on screen and one page; 不替任何人权衡 stays in the one page's case paragraph, not repeated.

(1) Pins that hold sentences these replace: tools/research/tests/test_navigation_pages.py test_the_ethics_emerges_from_continuation (ONE-PAGE phrases from 'A course *widens*' to 'every additive weighting ... ranks it above'), the lead pins near lines 337-349 ('on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths ...'), the zh pins near 830-831 and 889-925 ('有一种次序，这里称为*自我关切*', '在一个有限列表上，自我关切的次序...'); test_chinese_fronts for README-ZH; test_uses_pages if USES In brief changes. (2) Quotes of the replaced sentences elsewhere, to move or name in 'left': MAP.md line 9's ethics parenthesis; GLOSSARY rows ranking/order, C, self-concern, 生生, widening (keep widening as relation there); THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING §7 'How far concern reaches' and its Alignment paragraph's third condition; USES In brief; ONE-PAGE 'Alignment' ('and courses are compared by widening') and ONE-PAGE.zh 对齐 ('诸进程按扩大来比较'); _process/goals/generative-alignment.json objective and overview.summary (three conditions); COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION; the ALIGNMENT dossier. (3) The one page's case paragraph after the ethics keeps the lake's lesson and figures; suggest keeping 'If thirty a month loses nothing fifty admits, adding the bed, it widens fifty; if it ends a livelihood fifty keeps, the two are mixed, and the laws weigh them for no one' and dropping its 'every additive weighting ... ranks it higher' clause, the ranking-by-widening the round named. (4) Left: AJ's PLAN still lists three conditions while the fronts and goal JSON would state two; the plan is its owner's. Also flagged, not resolved: AGENTS.md's 'does not come to select for control over its own selection', read literally, is the pre-AJ5 wording that AJ5 found forbidding accountable revision; 'Read on the map, it asks two things' lets AJ's restated condition 1 (control not captured) say what the sentence asks there; whether the sentence should change is Ren's, as the screen's note already says. (5) A possible dynamics connection not added for length: 07 §4.14 (readings revised at descent, spreading by share while what feeds their carriers lasts, locking where variation is drawn from what is present) could take one clause on the one page or USES beside the open target.
